name: Fleet of Foot
text: [Trait] All `ELF RANGERS` fighters have this trait. Once per activation, this fighter can make a free Move action.

name: Unerring Aim
text: [Trait] All `ELF RANGERS` fighters have this trait. Once per battle round, when this fighter makes a ranged attack action with a Bow or Elven Bow and haven't made a Move action yet in their activation, the weapon gains the **Pierce 1** special rule.
